columns.tooltip: Relative widths separated by colons. 1:1:1 gives three equal columns, 1:2:1 a wide centre column, 1:1 two halves.

split-delay.description: Hold time before a column splits in two
split-delay.tooltip: Keep the dragged window over the same column this long and the column divides into a top and a bottom half. Moving to another column starts the wait again. 0 turns splitting off.
